messages:
sasha: heads-up — found a parity bug between REST and python-sdk for async embeddings. curl returns 202 + Location and job runs fine, but python-sdk raises and retries so we end up creating duplicate async jobs. reproducer below

sasha: curl (works)
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async \\ 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' \\ 
  -d '{"model":"embed-lite","input":["a","b"]}'
# -> HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
# -> Location: /v1/jobs/ab12cd
```

sasha: python-sdk (fails & retries)
```
from redwood import RedwoodClient
c = RedwoodClient(api_key=os.getenv('KEY'))
job = c.embeddings.create_async(model="embed-lite", input=["a","b"])
# raises HTTPError("unexpected status: 202") and our retry loop re-sends
```

sasha: quick root cause guess: client treats non-200 as error instead of 2xx success class, and it also doesn't surface Location for polling. billing/users see two jobs. cc @kevin for SDK fix?

kevin: ugh, that explains the duplicate jobs reported by support. thanks for the repro. i'm checking client/http.py now. i think we used `if resp.status_code != 200: raise` in a spot we missed when async endpoints were added.

kevin: short patch I tested locally fixes it: accept any 2xx and populate job_id from Location header. snippet: 
```
- if resp.status_code != 200:
-     raise HTTPError(...)
+ if resp.status_code < 200 or resp.status_code >= 300:
+     raise HTTPError(...)
+ job_loc = resp.headers.get('Location')
+ if job_loc:
+     return Job.from_id(job_loc.split('/')[-1])
```

maria: nice catch. can we add an integration test that mocks a 202 + Location and asserts no retry + job id returned? also note we need parity across node and go sdks.

liam: agree on tests. also flagging this as a high-priority regression — customer reported billing headache. might need a hotfix release for python and node.

maria: for rollout, let's do: 1) quick patch + unit/integration tests 2) cut a patch release to python sdk 1.4.3 3) call out in changelog + notify support to reconcile duplicates 4) check telemetry if retries spiked last 24h

kevin: working on PR now. will include test and changelog entry. tagging @devex-bot to create issue.

devex-bot: Created issue #3456: "python-sdk: accept 2xx for async endpoints and parse Location header to avoid duplicate async jobs" assigned to kevin, priority: high. <https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/3456> :white_check_mark:

sasha: thanks all. follow-up: maybe we should add a small e2e script in our onboarding sample app that hits an async endpoint so we catch this in CI next time. low-effort but high ROI.

kevin: good idea. I'll add an e2e step that uses the test harness job stub. will ping here when PR is up. :thumbsup:
